deprecated_yaml_import_issue.title: The Untappd YAML configuration could not be imported
deprecated_yaml_import_issue.description:
Configuring Untappd via `sensor: - platform: untappd` in configuration.yaml is deprecated and the YAML block for user `{username}` could not be imported automatically (reason: {reason}).

Fix the credentials in configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant, or remove the YAML block and set Untappd up from Settings > Devices & services instead.
